default.promotionalText: Your alarm, set by your calendar. EarlyOtter finds your first event, subtracts prep and commute, and wakes you right on time. No early plans? Sleep in.
default.description:
EarlyOtter sets your alarm from your calendar.

It finds your first event of the day, subtracts your prep time and commute, and schedules a real alarm, so you wake up exactly when you need to. No early plans? It lets you sleep in until your latest wake-up time.

• Works with Apple Calendar and Google Calendar
• Prep and commute time built in
• Custom rules for classes, flights, the gym or work
• Standby alarms for quiet mornings; days off stay silent
• Real alarms that ring even on silent
• Private by design: your calendar is read on your iPhone and never uploaded
default.whatsNew:
• A cleaner, simpler Settings screen
• Rate EarlyOtter right from Settings
• Reliability improvements
